versions.changelog:
- Added a "Finding endpoints and types" section to documentation, explaining how to look up methods and parameters using Go tools.
- Expanded usage guidance for method signatures and HubSpot operation ID patterns.
- Clarified how to browse API documentation via go doc and pkg.go.dev.
- Added license declaration (MIT) in metadata.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- No functional or code changes; this update cleans up documentation files only.

Initial release of go-hubspot skill — unofficial Go client for HubSpot API.

- Adds support for interacting with all 721 paths in HubSpot’s unified OpenAPI spec via typed Go methods.
- Enables authentication using either a private app Bearer token or OAuth access token (via env variable).
- Provides typed responses (`JSON200`/`JSON201`) for all endpoints, including CRM, associations, search, marketing, CMS, automation, conversations, files, and webhooks.
- Use when Go code needs to read or write HubSpot data or already imports `github.com/psyb0t/go-hubspot`.
- Designed for use in Go projects; not suitable for non-Go environments or for endpoints outside HubSpot’s unified spec.
- Usage examples and security guidelines included in documentation.
